child.text:
[{"insert":"Front Rack Split Squat

The front rack split squat holds the load in the front rack position, which demands more core and upper back engagement to stay upright than a goblet or suitcase hold. The split stance isolates each leg independently. Keep the front heel flat and drive through it on every rep. Reps drop across the odd weeks, so the weight goes up each time it returns.
"}]
